exclusion_criteria.text: Required Screening Information Demographics: age, sex, height, weight, pregnancy/breastfeeding status where applicable. AMI data: STEMI/NSTEMI, symptom onset, admission date/time, ECG findings, troponin and CK-MB where available, and diagnosis. Cardiovascular data: BP, heart rate, rhythm, heart failure signs, cardiogenic shock, angiography, PCI/CABG and dates. Laboratory data: creatinine/eGFR, liver tests, hemoglobin, platelets, electrolytes and protocol safety tests. Medical history: prior MI, heart failure, stroke/TIA, diabetes, hypertension, renal/liver disease, bleeding, allergies, infection, surgery/trauma and medications. Trial history: prior investigational products and participation in other interventional studies.
